decision.profile: H.264 High 4:4:4 Predictive (yuv444p), bt709 tags, faststart; scale in RGB with flags=neighbor
decision.why: M-124 (>= 99 % of pixels within dE00 2.0, every sampled frame) is unchanged; yuv420p fails it at every master scale and every CRF down to 0 (chroma subsampling bleeds across the dither/block edges), see by_pix_fmt
decision.master_scale: 4 (1920x1080 = the delivery size; smaller masters would need a player-side resample)
decision.open_founder_row: Steam player / browser / hardware-decode compatibility of H.264 4:4:4 playback is unverified (4:4:4 is not universally hardware-decoded); if it fails the fallback is a separately labelled 4:2:0 encode that cannot pass M-124, not a relaxed gate
decision.bitrate_note: estimated_bitrate_kbps_on_matrix_frames is for the 60 matrix frames (sparse motion); M-122 requires >= 5000 kbps on the trailer, which the real, busier trailer content is expected to exceed at this CRF; if it does not, lower the CRF (never raise it) or pad with a higher floor
